headline: Philippine stock market snaps three-day winning streak on lack of fresh leads
summary: The Philippine stock market snapped its three-day winning streak as investors stayed on the sidelines due to a lack of fresh economic catalysts.
why: Benchmark equity indices fluctuate based on localized trading volumes and macroeconomic sentiment shifts.

impacts.name: PSEi Index
impacts.why: The index measures overall price performance of equities on the Philippine Stock Exchange.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investors remained on the sidelines amid a lack of fresh market leads, halting a three-day advance.
